name: ak:retro
overview: Generate data-driven sprint retrospectives from any git history. Use for sprint reviews, commit analysis, code-health indicators, team-velocity reporting, and quarterly engineering reviews. Works on solo or team repos.
whenToUse: Invoke to summarize engineering history from git activity.

flags.name: --compare
flags.desc: Compare metrics against the preceding equal-length period

subcommands.name: timeframe
subcommands.desc: Period to analyze. Accepts: 7d, 2w, 1m, sprint, or YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD
